    AI Overview
    Vanessa Trump (formerly Vanessa Kay Haydon, born 1977/1978) is a former model, actress, and the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr., with whom she shares five children
    . She is currently known as the girlfriend of golfer Tiger Woods as of early 2026. She was married to Trump Jr. from 2005 to 2018 and has maintained a relatively private life since. 
    Key Facts About Vanessa Trump 
    • Background: Born to Bonnie Kay Haydon and a father with Italian heritage, she grew up in New York City and attended the Dwight School.
    • Career: She was a model signed with Wilhelmina Models and appeared in the 2003 film Something's Gotta Give. She also briefly operated a handbag line, "La Posche," in 2010
      .
    • Relationship with Trump Jr.: Introduced by Donald Trump in 2003, she married Donald Trump Jr. in 2005 at Mar-a-Lago. The couple divorced in 2018.
    • Current Relationship: As of March 2026, she is in a relationship with Tiger Woods, often appearing with her children at his golf events.
    • Family: She is the mother of five children: Kai, Donald III, Tristan, Spencer, and Chloe. 
    She is the former daughter-in-law of U.S. President Donald Trump and Ivana Trump.
